items.text: Baltimore QB: Lamar Jackson and Tyler Huntley both on IR; Jacoby Brissett starts again. The schedule still lists Huntley.

Baltimore (Wed/Thu): DNP both days - DT Nnamdi Madubuike (hamstring). G Vega Ioane (shoulder) upgraded to full Thu. LIMITED - S Jaylinn Hawkins (knee). RB Adam Randall activated from IR. IR - C Ethan Pocic, G Jovaughn Gwyn, K Tyler Loop.

Carolina (Wed/Thu): DNP - LB Bobby Okereke (foot), S Isaiah Simmons (knee). TEs Darren Waller and Tommy Tremble back at practice Thu. CB Will Lee III full. OT Ikem Ekwonu on PUP, OT Taylor Moton on IR (fibula), CB Jaycee Horn IR. Bryce Young (foot) full, starts.
